name: SHARP HSNKL Half Marathon 2026
short_description: A 21.1km half marathon held on October 25, 2026 at Dataran Merdeka, Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia, with registration currently open.
ai_summary: The SHARP HSNKL Half Marathon 2026 is a half marathon event taking place on October 25, 2026, starting at Dataran Merdeka in Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia. The race covers a distance of 21.1 kilometers. Registration for this event is currently open, allowing runners to secure their spot ahead of the race day.
pros: Registration is currently open, giving runners time to plan and sign up
Iconic starting location at Dataran Merdeka in the heart of Kuala Lumpur
Standard half marathon distance of 21.1km suitable for experienced and intermediate runners
research_highlights: The 2026 edition will be the event's 4th year, following a 3rd edition in 2025 that marked the 10th anniversary of Hari Sukan Negara.
Race day start is very early — official rules for the 2025 edition listed a 3:00 AM flag-off at KLCC, Jln P. Ramlee, likely to beat KL's daytime heat and humidity.
The event offers multiple distances alongside the half marathon: 21KM, 10KM, 5KM and 3KM routes, making it a family/mass-participation weekend rather than an elite-only race.
It is organised by Sharp Malaysia together with Kita Pelari Malaysia and Pure Events, with support from Kuala Lumpur City Hall (DBKL) and the Ministry of Youth and Sports.
Run kit collection has historically been held in the days just before race day (e.g. 16–18 Oct for the 2025 edition), so factor in an extra trip to KL before race weekend.
